:::caution[deprecated]

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

:::

Consumes a reservation: for every Allocation it holds, the allocated quantity is physically removed from its StockUnit (StockUnit transitions toward PICKED/REMOVED) and the corresponding bin capacity is released. This is a terminal, one-way command on the resource in the domain command style (not forced into PUT/PATCH) — a reservation that is already resolved, expired, or has no allocations cannot be confirmed again. Superseded by the TaskCompleted consumer (K37: fulfillment-execution's TaskCompleted for a PICK task confirms the reservation — ADR 0035 / ADR 0036); removal planned with the next breaking window.
